entities.name: Halid Bešlić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Halid Bešlić was a Bosnian folk singer and musician whose career spanned nearly five decades. Renowned for his distinctive baritone voice and emotive delivery, he became one of the most influential and best-selling performers in the former Yugoslavia and throughout the Balkans.
